$comment: Brazilian mobile numbers for contact discovery (proseio docs/usernames.md layer 5). normalizePhone(text): keep a leading '+' and the digits of the first maxInputLength characters; '00' at the start means '+'. With '+': the country code must be countryCode. Without '+': drop a trunk prefix '0' plus a two-digit carrier code (0 + carrier + area + subscriber), or a bare trunk '0', or a leading countryCode, to reach area code + subscriber. The area code must be in areaCodes; the subscriber must be mobileLength digits starting with mobilePrefix. Result: '+' + countryCode + area code + subscriber, or null. Numbers outside Brazil, landlines and numbers without an area code are null. Cases: test-vectors/phone-numbers.json.
